name: platform-workspace
description: Ties the checked-out frontends together so a module resolves @platform/shared-ui by version, from the checkout beside it, with no registry in between. Owned by dev-starter because it is part of the development environment, not of any module; linked into the checkout root by npm-workspace.sh, because node resolves a package by walking a directory's ancestors and only a file up there is on that path.
